About Azentio  

Azentio Software incorporated in 2020 at Singapore, has been carved out of 3i 
Infotech, Candela Labs, Beyontec Technologies and Path Solutions. Azentio 
Software provides mission critical, vertical-specific software products for 
customers in banking, financial services and insurance verticals and includes 
key products such as KASTLE™ (Universal Lending), AMLOCK™ (Anti-Money 
Laundering & Compliance software suite), iMal, PREMIA™ Astra (Core Insurance 
software), ORION™ (Enterprise Resource Planning software) and MFUND Plus™ 
(Asset Management platform). Azentio has over 800 customers in more than 60 
countries, with a team of over 2,300 employees across offices in 12 countries 
(and growing) globally and is wholly owned by Funds advised by Apax Partners. 

Azentio offers a comprehensive range of products – serving core operations to 
modern digital needs – for the financial services industry. Our deep domain 
knowledge and solutions in financial services extend across insurance, retail 
and corporate lending, Islamic Banking, anti-money laundering and asset 
management. In addition, Azentio proudly serves mid-market enterprises across 
the Middle East, Africa, Asia Pacific, and India with a comprehensive ERP 
solution.  

At Azentio, we believe that growth is a continuous journey. We believe that 
each step of this journey must be taken by committing to excellence - 
excellence in our products, our services, our ideas, and our people.  

 

Job Title: Senior Software Engineer - Oracle Forms & Reports

Years of Experience: 5 to 7 years 

Location: Chennai 

 

Role Summary: 

We are seeking a skilled Oracle Forms and Reports Developer who brings a 
wealth of experience in Oracle D2K, SQL, PL/SQL, and enterprise application 
development. The successful candidate will demonstrate a proven track record in 
designing, developing, enhancing, and maintaining robust business applications 
utilising Oracle Forms (versions 10g/11g/12c/14c) and Oracle Reports. This role 
requires hands-on expertise in building and optimising database-driven 
solutions, with the ability to translate complex business requirements into 
effective technical solutions.




The ideal applicant should be adept at developing and fine-tuning PL/SQL 
packages, procedures, functions, triggers, and views, ensuring efficient and 
reliable performance. Experience with performance tuning of PL/SQL code and SQL 
queries is essential. The candidate should also possess solid skills in 
debugging and troubleshooting application issues across Oracle Forms, Reports, 
and PL/SQL programmes.




Additionally, the role demands proficiency in migrating and upgrading legacy 
Oracle Forms/Reports applications to newer platforms (such as 12c/14c), as well 
as designing and modifying data models, tables, indexes, and other key database 
objects. Familiarity with integrating Oracle Forms and Reports with external 
systems (including Java components, web services, and CSV/XML outputs) will be 
highly valued. Effective collaboration with QA teams, Business Analysts, and 
other cross-functional stakeholders for system testing and user acceptance 
testing is also a critical aspect of this position.

 

What will you do?  

·        Responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining applications 
utilizing Oracle Forms (10g/11g/12c/14c) and Oracle Reports.

·        Develop and optimize PL/SQL packages, procedures, functions, 
triggers, and views in alignment with application requirements.

·        Analyze business requirements and translate them into comprehensive 
technical specifications.

·        Perform performance tuning of PL/SQL code and SQL queries to ensure 
optimal efficiency.

·        Diagnose and resolve issues within Oracle Forms, Reports, and PL/SQL 
programs.

·        Execute migration and upgrade activities for Oracle Forms/Reports 
applications to current versions (12c/14c).

·        Create and revise data models, tables, indexes, materialized views, 
and other database objects as needed.

·        Integrate Oracle Forms & Reports seamlessly with external systems, 
including Java components, web services, and CSV/XML outputs.

·        Collaborate effectively with QA, Business Analysts, and 
cross-functional teams to facilitate system testing and user acceptance testing 
(UAT).

·        Deliver production support, conduct root cause analysis, and carry 
out ongoing performance optimization.

 

What skills required? 

·        5+ years of Oracle Forms and Reports development experience

·        Advanced skills in Oracle SQL and PL/SQL (triggers, packages, 
procedures, functions, query optimization)

·        Experience with Oracle Database versions 10g to 23ai

·        Strong grasp of database design, normalization, and data modeling

·        Skilled in debugging and troubleshooting PL/SQL

·        Familiar with deployment tools like SQL Developer and TOAD

·        Proficient with Unix/Linux scripts and automation

·        Comfortable working in Agile/Scrum teams

·        Insurance sector experience preferred

·        Experience with Premia or Beyontec products an advantage




 What we Aim for? 

Azentio aims to be the leading provider of Banking, Financial Services & 
Insurance (BFSI) & Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) software products in Asia 
Pacific, Middle East & Africa & United States. We will achieve this by: 


 * Providing world class software products, built on the latest technologies. 
 * Providing best in class customer service, built on a deep understanding of 
our domains and local nuances. 
 * Being an employer of choice, attracting high quality talent. 
 * Achieving top quartile growth and margins.  

Azentio Core Values:  

·        Customer centricity - Put customers at the center of everything

·        Innovation - Keep looking for a better way

·        Accountability - Own your work, end-to-end

·        Results - Focus on outcomes, not just effort
